body: As I've mentioned in a number of issue now, `go-gitea/git` really needs to `panic()` if the git-version is below a certain value 😂

issue.title: Panic if Git version is < GitVersionRequired

repository.name: git
repository.description: A Go module for Git access through shell

issue.body:
Panic during init() if Git version is < GitVersionRequired.
I have set the min version to 1.7.10 as required by SetDefaultBranch (https://github.com/go-gitea/git/blob/master/repo_branch.go#L58). I'm not sure why 1.7.10 is required for SetDefaultBranch, symbolic-ref has been in there for a while https://git-scm.com/docs/git-symbolic-ref/1.4.4.

Ref: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/1133

body: So I think maybe we have to ask git 1.8 to let release work.
@lunny I think we should have a test-suite for `go-gitea/git` so we can _know_ what version we require. Guessing is never a good idea 😄
